scripts.lint: pnpm test:prepare && eslint eslint.config.mjs vitest.workspace.ts playwright.config.ts apps/api/vitest.e2e.config.ts scripts/*.mjs tests/e2e/**/*.ts && pnpm -r --if-present lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm test:prepare && pnpm -r --if-present typecheck && pnpm typecheck:e2e
scripts.test: pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:api-e2e
scripts.test:unit: pnpm test:prepare && vitest run --config vitest.workspace.ts --project unit
scripts.test:integration: pnpm test:prepare && vitest run --config vitest.workspace.ts --project integration
scripts.test:e2e: node --test scripts/run-playwright.test.mjs && docker compose down && node scripts/run-playwright.mjs
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm privacy:check && pnpm test:e2e
